svg.title: 架构 / Architecture
svg.desc: Electron 外壳、命令行或 Docker 启动 Node.js + TypeScript 后端，后端包含 Preact 界面、SQLite、DSH 智能体运行时和渠道适配，再调用内置的 magpie 网关，由它连到 Modelflare。 Electron shell, command line or Docker start a Node.js and TypeScript backend with a Preact UI, SQLite, the DSH agent runtime and channel adapters, which call the bundled magpie gateway, which calls Modelflare.
